# v1.1.0-dev.118: Clicks that land, tab restored, rows unsquished

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.117`.

## Hover-yes-click-no, the second cause

A container could still react to hovers while its clicks did nothing. The
press-time foreground handover was already gone; the second thief was the
RELEASE-time one, which ran inside the mouse hook before the click itself
had been dispatched, and moving the foreground in that instant releases
the capture the click was still using. The handover now waits one tick
for the click to land first.

## The title bar tab, restored

The tab above a virtual window with its title bar hidden carries its
three buttons again -- show the title bar, manage windows, and collapsed
windows (which appears only while something is collapsed) -- at its
original size and position, after the one-button cut read as moving it.

## The docked-windows list, unsquished

The "when a profile loads" cluster had grown a second checkbox and outgrew
its column, squishing the row. The column is a proper share of the row
now, the two per-app checkboxes are labelled "Default" and "Close" with
the full sentences in their tooltips, and everything fits one line with
the undock button back in alignment.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
